title: Everything in one place in /setup
changes: /setup now lists the add-ons too, with whether each one is on: Server Directory, Safety Network, RPM CyberCom, Voice moderation and Session Recaps
Voice moderation has its own place: /config voicemoderation, and Voice moderation in the /setup menu
New: /config cybercom and /config safetynetwork open those settings straight away, and /help has an Add-ons page
